text: Jesurun Rak-Sakyi
Winger Jesurun Rak-Sakyi, who a number of clubs have shown interest in this summer, scored the only goal of the game.

Jesurun Rak-Sakyi of Crystal Palace is attracting increasing interest from Rangers, Sheffield United, and Southampton, all of whom are interested in the winger, whose valuation by the Eagles stands around £10 million.

The 22-year-old winger Jesurun Rak-Sakyi, who has returned to Crystal Palace following his loan at Sheffield United, is being pursued by Rangers. However, the Ibrox club is looking to either secure him on loan or negotiate a reduction from the £10m asking price.
Wingers Sabah Kerjota and Pierre Landry Kabore, who have often been mentioned as potential Hearts players for this season, are probably among the new signings.

Hearts have agreed terms with Pierre Landry Kabore, but a transfer fee is still to be agreed with Narva Trans for the Burkina Faso winger while talks are also progressing with Italian fourth-tier outfit Sambendetese for Albanian wide man Sabah Kerjota.
